fix_subject: Reject CREATE TEMPORARY INDEX / TRIGGER, inherit trigger temporariness
pr_title: Similar to https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/25118, this I am less

labels.summary: A user-written TEMPORARY on CREATE INDEX or CREATE TRIGGER was accepted by the PEG grammar and either raised an INTERNAL catalog invariant error or was mishandled, and triggers on temporary tables failed or were persisted; the fix rejects an explicit TEMPORARY and makes a trigger inherit its base table's temporariness.
